observations: Transcriptome analysis of proton pump inhibitor-responsive esophageal eosinophilia reveals proton pump inhibitor-reversible allergic inflammation.

entities.name: PPI reverses allergic transcriptome
observations: In PPI-responsive esophageal eosinophilia, esophageal biopsy transcriptomes substantially overlapped with EoE, including CCL26, DSG1, POSTN, and CPA3; PPI monotherapy almost completely reversed the allergic-inflammatory transcriptome.
